stories.title: New Knesset Speaker Elected in Israel, Signaling Shift in Government Dynamics
stories.summary: The Israeli parliament has elected Matan Kahana as the new speaker, marking a significant shift in the Knesset following Benjamin Netanyahu's loss of majority. Kahana, an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, received 66 votes in the 120-member chamber, indicating a move towards reversing policies from the outgoing government led by Netanyahu.
